meta.title: K-Export Stars — Korean Sector Performance (KRX indices)
meta.source: Korea Exchange (KRX) Open API — official index series
meta.methodology: Returns computed from KRX settled daily closes. 1w = 5 trading sessions, 1m = 21 sessions, YTD = first session of the year. Excess return is the sector's 1-month return minus its market benchmark (KOSPI or KOSDAQ), in percentage points.
meta.why: KRX sector indices are not carried by mainstream English-language finance sites. A single index level hides which part of the market moved.
meta.note: Derived returns only — not a redistribution of the underlying index series. Not investment advice.
